PLEASE STAY AT HOME, WASH YOUR HANDS DAILY AND STAY SAFE
Hello all yeh hai ek special video aap sab k lie
presenting to you “LOCKDOWN WITH PARIVAR”
PRODUCTION :
Camera : ek tripod stand liya aur har scene akela shoot kiya because Social Distancing zaroori hai.
Sound : wo bhi sync mein akele sambhalna pada kyunki Social Distancing zaroori hai.
Make up : mirror ke saamne khud hi lagaya aur shirt ke neeche chaddi pehni thi kyunki social distancing zaroori hai.
co stars : jadoo ke scene usne apne ghar pe shoot kiye aur simran ne apne, fir google drive se muje scene bheje unhone
